learn.rule: Joining words connect ideas. When, before, and until tell time. Because tells the reason. Although shows a surprise.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras de unión conectan ideas. When, before y until dicen el tiempo. Because dice la razón. Although muestra una sorpresa.
learn.model: We carry umbrellas when it rains.
learn.notice: The word when joins two ideas and tells the time we carry umbrellas.

items.prompt: What does the joining word because tell the reader in this sentence?
items.text: We wear boots because the snow is deep.

options.text: a time
a reason
a surprise

items.why: Because tells why we wear boots: the snow is deep.
items.whyEs: Because dice por qué usamos botas: la nieve es profunda.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells the time for frost.
items.model: Frost forms on the grass when the night is freezing.
items.why: When tells the time that frost forms. The other words do not fit the meaning.
items.whyEs: When dice cuándo se forma la escarcha. Las otras palabras no encajan con el significado.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells how long we stayed inside.
items.model: We stayed inside until the storm ended.
items.why: Until tells how long: up to the moment the storm ended.
items.whyEs: Until dice por cuánto tiempo: hasta el momento en que terminó la tormenta.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a joining word to show a surprise about the sun and the wind?

options.text: Although the sun was out, the wind felt chilly.
Because the sun was out, the wind felt chilly.
Until the sun was out, the wind felt chilly.

items.why: Sunshine usually feels warm, so a chilly wind is a surprise. Although shows that.
items.whyEs: El sol suele sentirse cálido, así que un viento frío es una sorpresa. Although muestra eso.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells what Mia did first.
items.model: Mia checked the forecast before she packed her bag.
items.why: Before tells that checking the forecast came first, then packing.
items.whyEs: Before dice que revisar el pronóstico fue primero, y luego empacar.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses a joining word to give a reason.

options.text: The pond froze because the nights were freezing.
The pond froze after the nights turned cold.
We wore mittens because our hands were cold.
We wore mittens until our hands felt warm.

items.why: Because gives a reason. After and until tell about time.
items.whyEs: Because da una razón. After y until hablan del tiempo.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about weather. Use when, because, or until.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre el clima. Usa when, because o until.
write.model: We bring umbrellas when the sky turns dark.

familyTalk.en: Look outside together. Say one sentence about today's weather using when, because, or until.
familyTalk.es: Miren afuera juntos. Digan una oración sobre el clima de hoy usando when, because o until.

teacherTip.en: Sort sentence strips by what the joining word tells: time, reason, or surprise.
teacherTip.es: Clasifica tiras de oraciones según lo que dice la palabra de unión: tiempo, razón o sorpresa.

sets.title: Joining Words at Town Hall
sets.titleEs: Palabras de unión en la alcaldía

learn.rule: Joining words connect ideas. After, before, and while tell time. If tells what happens when something is true.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras de unión conectan ideas. After, before y while dicen el tiempo. If dice qué pasa cuando algo es verdad.
learn.model: The mayor spoke after the parade ended.
learn.notice: After tells which happened later: the speech came when the parade was over.

items.prompt: What does the joining word while tell the reader in this sentence?
items.text: Dad cooked while we set the table.

options.text: two things happen at the same time
a reason
a result

items.why: While means at the same time. Dad cooked and we set the table together.
items.whyEs: While significa al mismo tiempo. Papá cocinaba y nosotros poníamos la mesa a la vez.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells what happens first with lunch.
items.model: We wash our hands before we eat lunch.
items.why: Before tells that washing happens first, then eating.
items.whyEs: Before dice que lavarse ocurre primero, y luego comer.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells what happens at the same time as reading.
items.model: Maria read a book while her brother played outside.
items.why: While joins two things happening together.
items.whyEs: While une dos cosas que pasan a la vez.

items.prompt: Which joining word tells a condition? ___ the road is closed, the buses will take another way.

options.text: Although
If
Until

items.why: If tells what will happen when something is true: the road is closed.
items.whyEs: If dice qué pasará cuando algo es verdad: el camino está cerrado.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows a surprise about the parade.
parts: it was raining, the parade went on.
items.model: Although it was raining, the parade went on.
items.why: Rain usually stops a parade, so going on is a surprise. Although shows that.
items.whyEs: La lluvia suele detener un desfile, así que seguir es una sorpresa. Although muestra eso.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses a joining word to show time.

options.text: The band played after the speech ended.
The band played because the crowd cheered.
We clapped while the band played.
We clapped although the song was long.

items.why: After and while tell when things happen. Because gives a reason and although shows a surprise.
items.whyEs: After y while dicen cuándo pasan las cosas. Because da una razón y although muestra una sorpresa.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about your town. Use after, while, or because.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre tu pueblo. Usa after, while o because.
write.model: We walk to the library after school ends.

familyTalk.en: Tell each other what you do after dinner and what you do while you wait for the bus.
familyTalk.es: Cuéntense qué hacen después de la cena y qué hacen mientras esperan el autobús.

teacherTip.en: Act out while with two students doing two things at once to make the meaning clear.
teacherTip.es: Representa while con dos estudiantes haciendo dos cosas a la vez para aclarar el significado.

sets.title: Math Story Joiners
sets.titleEs: Palabras de unión en problemas de matemáticas

learn.rule: Joining words connect ideas. If tells a condition. Because tells a reason. Although shows a surprise.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras de unión conectan ideas. If dice una condición. Because dice una razón. Although muestra una sorpresa.
learn.model: If you add two and three, you get five.
learn.notice: If starts a condition. The second part tells what happens when the condition is true.

items.prompt: What does the joining word if tell the reader in the math sentence?
items.text: If you add two and three, you get five.

options.text: a condition: what happens when something is true
a surprise
a reason

items.why: If sets up a condition. When you add two and three, the result is five.
items.whyEs: If plantea una condición. Cuando sumas dos y tres, el resultado es cinco.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that gives a reason for counting by tens.
items.model: We count by tens because it helps us count faster.
items.why: It helps us count faster is the reason, so because fits.
items.whyEs: It helps us count faster es la razón, así que because encaja.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows a surprise about Tia.
items.model: Tia was tired, although she finished her math homework.
items.why: Being tired makes finishing harder, so finishing is a surprise. Although shows that.
items.whyEs: Estar cansada hace más difícil terminar, así que terminar es una sorpresa. Although muestra eso.

items.prompt: Which sentence about rounding uses a joining word to give a reason?

options.text: We rounded the number because it was close to ten.
We rounded the number after the quiz.
We rounded the number until the bell rang.

items.why: Because gives the reason for rounding. After and until tell about time.
items.whyEs: Because da la razón para redondear. After y until hablan del tiempo.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells a condition for buying the book.
items.model: Ava will buy the book if she saves ten dollars.
items.why: If tells what has to happen first: Ava has to save ten dollars.
items.whyEs: If dice qué tiene que pasar primero: Ava tiene que ahorrar diez dólares.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that shows a surprise with a joining word.

options.text: Although the problem looked hard, it was easy.
We checked our work because we wanted to be sure.
Although it was late, Dev kept counting.
Dev counted until the bell rang.

items.why: Although shows an unexpected turn. Because gives a reason and until tells how long.
items.whyEs: Although muestra un giro inesperado. Because da una razón y until dice por cuánto tiempo.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about math. Use if, because, or before.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre matemáticas. Usa if, because o before.
write.model: If I add five and five, I get ten.

familyTalk.en: Make a math sentence with if at home, like 'If we have four plates and add two, we have six.'
familyTalk.es: Hagan una oración de matemáticas con if en casa, como 'If we have four plates and add two, we have six.'

teacherTip.en: Have students say the same math fact with if, then with because, and compare the meaning.
teacherTip.es: Pide que digan el mismo dato de matemáticas con if y luego con because, y comparen el significado.
